prompt:
[Image Type]
Editorial illustration in minimalist magazine cover style

[Content]
- Central element: Single abstract 3D shape (smooth flowing form) representing AI choice and creativity
- Symbolic representation: Subtle curved paths or light rays converging toward the focal point
- Minimal decorative elements: 2-3 small floating abstract shapes suggesting video frames
- Background: Soft gradient with generous negative space
- No text, no literal screenshots, purely symbolic

[Style]
- Composition: 60% negative space with wide margins, focal point positioned using golden ratio
- Lighting: Soft ambient glow emanating from central element
- Depth: Gentle 3D layering with subtle shadows
- Format: 16:9 widescreen, horizontal orientation
- Aesthetic: Breathable, clean, professional, symbolic

[Brand Layer]
Brand aesthetic: alici.ai (Stripe-inspired minimalism, green-centered)

Color palette:
- GREEN-CENTERED gradient: deep emerald (#059669) → fresh mint (#10B981) → soft light green (#A7F3D0)
- Smooth multi-tone transitions with sophisticated muted saturation
- Background primarily white/very light with gradient accents

Style elements (from Stripe):
- Generous negative space (60%+ of canvas is white or subtle gradient)
- Soft 3D elements with gentle shadows and highlights
- Single clear focal point (the abstract flowing shape)
- Clean, breathable composition with implied gentle motion
- Modern, professional, trustworthy visual language
- Symbolic abstraction: no literal product screenshots or interfaces

Avoid:
- Blue/purple Stripe colors (strict green palette only)
- Saturated or loud colors
- Cluttered layouts with multiple focal points
- Literal photographic representations
- Dense information or text

[Image Type]
Minimalist infographic illustration for AI tool comparison

[Content]
- Abstract comparison concept: 3 vertical abstract shapes of different heights (representing quality tiers)
- Symbolic elements: Simple geometric icons above each shape (star, checkmark, trophy)
- Subtle connecting element: Thin horizontal line or gradient bar linking the shapes
- Minimal data visualization: Abstract representation, no detailed text or tables
- Background: Mostly white space with subtle gradient

[Style]
- Composition: 50% negative space, three-element horizontal layout with ample breathing room
- Visual hierarchy: Clear but subtle differences in shape heights
- Color coding: Green gradient applied to shapes (darker = better)
- Format: 16:9 widescreen
- Aesthetic: Clean, symbolic, easy to grasp at a glance

[Brand Layer]
Brand aesthetic: alici.ai (Stripe-inspired minimalism, green-centered)

Color palette:
- GREEN gradient system applied to comparison elements:
  - Left shape: deep emerald (#059669) - represents lower tier
  - Center shape: fresh mint (#10B981) - represents mid tier  
  - Right shape: soft light green (#A7F3D0) with subtle glow - represents top tier
- Background: primarily white (#FFFFFF) with very subtle gradient

Style elements:
- Generous white space (50%+ empty canvas)
- Soft 3D shapes with gentle shadows
- Clean geometric abstraction (no literal charts or detailed tables)
- Symbolic representation of comparison (height/color = quality)
- Professional, easy-to-understand visual language

Avoid:
- Blue/purple tones
- Dense tables or text-heavy infographics
- Multiple focal points or cluttered elements
- Literal screenshots or photographic elements

[Image Type]
Minimalist decision flowchart illustration

[Content]
- Starting point: Single abstract node/circle at top-center
- Decision paths: 3 clean curved flowing lines branching downward
- Endpoint elements: 3 simple geometric shapes at bottom (square, circle, triangle) representing different choices
- Minimal iconography: Tiny abstract symbols on each path (optional, very subtle)
- Visual flow: Gentle curves suggesting organic decision-making process
- No text labels, purely symbolic visual logic

[Style]
- Composition: 45% negative space, vertical flow from top to bottom
- Line style: Smooth curved paths with subtle thickness variation
- Format: 16:9 widescreen
- Aesthetic: Organic, flowing, simple, symbolic

[Brand Layer]
Brand aesthetic: alici.ai (Stripe-inspired minimalism, green-centered)

Color palette:
- GREEN gradient flow:
  - Starting node: deep emerald (#059669)
  - Paths: gradient transition from deep to light green
  - Endpoints: soft light green (#A7F3D0) to fresh mint (#10B981)
- Background: white (#FFFFFF) with very subtle gradient wash

Style elements:
- Generous negative space (45%+ white background)
- Soft 3D elements with gentle shadows on nodes and shapes
- Single clear visual flow from top to bottom
- Symbolic abstraction: paths represent choices without literal labels
- Clean, breathable, minimal composition
- Implied gentle motion through curved paths

Avoid:
- Blue/purple tones
- Complex detailed flowcharts with many boxes and arrows
- Text-heavy labels or explanations
- Cluttered multiple branches (keep it to 3 paths max)
- Literal photographic elements
